payload.description: The atomic staging and per-target lock implementation at commit 50ee194 addresses the live concurrent-clone race recorded by the original DATAP-19ad97 issue on the curation branch, but stale and abandoned states still wait until the 15-minute timeout. Correct the concurrency state machine so waiting is justified only by a live fresh lock, waiters re-evaluate when the lock disappears, stale locks are removed safely, abandoned staging directories cannot block progress, and incomplete legacy targets are repaired without racing an active owner. Add behavior-level process concurrency tests covering peer success, peer failure, stale lock, partial target without a lock, and recovery without a 15-minute wait.
payload.title: Recover stale or abandoned benchmark materialization state
